name: runtime_inspector_hierarchy
description: Read the live Cocos node tree of the embedded debug preview (requires the Creator debug preview panel). Bounded page: contains filters by node path, activeOnly hides inactive subtrees. Returns sessionId for follow-up calls; truncated/scanLimitReached mark coverage gaps.

name: runtime_inspector_layout
description: Flattened UI layout of the running game for design comparison: every node with a UITransform as x, y, width, height in design pixels with a top-left origin, plus anchor, scale, opacity, font size, color, sprite frame and (opt-in) label text. root limits to a subtree (node uuid), contains filters by path; activeOnly defaults to true. Needs the embedded debug preview.

name: runtime_inspector_layout_compare
description: Compare the running UI with design measurements: pass design boxes (name, x, y, width, height in the design canvas with a top-left origin, optional text, fontSize, color) taken from the design tool, and get per-element deltas against the live layout (dx, dy, dw, dh, text/fontSize/color matches), elements off tolerance, and what is unmatched on either side. scale/offsetX/offsetY convert the design canvas to the game design resolution; root/contains narrow the runtime side. Names are matched exactly, then case-insensitively, then by unique containment; duplicates pick the nearest node.

name: runtime_inspector_inspect
description: Read one live node: transform, prefab source, referenced assets, owning view and components with their fields (same data as the Runtime Properties panel). uuid and sessionId come from runtime_inspector_hierarchy; a reloaded page rejects stale sessions. componentId narrows to one component; all includes private fields. A password EditBox (and its text label) never returns its content, only the length; its inputFlag cannot be edited.

name: runtime_inspector_select
description: Select a live node in the Creator runtime hierarchy/properties panels and bring them forward, so the person sees what the AI refers to. No game mutation.

name: runtime_inspector_print
description: Print a node or component to the Creator console as readable JSON and expose it as $gd0 in the preview DevTools; returns the same record. A password EditBox (and its text label) never returns its content, only the length; its inputFlag cannot be edited.

name: runtime_inspector_status
description: Self-check of the debug tooling in one call: embedded preview binding, observer preference, collector hub (frame, session, node count, selection, pick/link switches), which Git Desk panels exist, what each open inspector surface currently renders (rows, names, selected node, component blocks, messages), and the extension's recent failures. Works without a preview; use it before asking a person to look at the editor.

name: browser_debug_export
description: Save one local evidence package under the debug output directory (agent-settings.json debug.outputDir, default ~/.cocos-git-desk/<projectId>/exports) with identity, UI states, merged timeline, pending requests and optional screenshot (default true). Refuses mixed page sessions. Screenshots may contain personal data. Captured request/response bodies, console text and WebSocket payloads are not included.

name: browser_debug_start
description: Start a fresh capture of the embedded preview page events (console, exceptions, network, navigation). Existing console history is skipped by default; WebSocket payload capture is opt-in and may contain private data.

name: browser_debug_status
description: Show preview connection, capture target, buffer range, dropped-event count and the observer preference.

name: browser_debug_events
description: Read a bounded page of captured events. By default returns the latest matches; use nextSinceId from the previous result to continue. Set latest=false with sinceId=0 to read from the oldest retained event. Reports buffer gaps.

name: browser_debug_summary
description: Summarize captured event categories, levels and recent errors since an event ID without dumping all logs.

name: browser_debug_mark
description: Add a short marker to the capture immediately before or after a manual reproduction step.

name: browser_debug_wait_for_reload
description: Wait up to 15 seconds for a main-frame navigation of the preview after an event ID. Reports timeout without claiming the code was compiled or reloaded.

name: browser_debug_compare
description: Compare two explicitly marked reproduction intervals: event counts, navigations and errors seen only in each interval. Differences are observations, not proof of a fix.

name: browser_debug_stop
description: Save the observer preference OFF, remove observers and stop the capture. Buffered events remain readable until the next start or the preview panel closes.
